name: Virag 3D Creative Library
principles: Use the current brief and current uploads only; never import an older campaign or topic unless explicitly referenced.
Every preset creates one standalone static 3D/CGI creative, never a video or storyboard.
Preserve product/package geometry, proportions, label, logo, artwork, colors and supplied identity exactly unless the current user explicitly requests a change.
Use physically believable scale, perspective, contact, materials, reflections, shadows and lighting.
Same preset means the same technique, not the same layout; avoid repeating floating-product, pedestal or smoke templates.
Do not invent product claims, prices, certifications, nutrition, specs, awards, testimonials or hidden internals.

commands.label: CGI Hero
commands.desc: Premium static 3D hero scene with monumental commercial presence.
commands.instruction: Create one premium static CGI hero creative. Make the current subject/product the unmistakable hero with physically believable 3D scale, materials, contact, reflections, shadows and cinematic lighting. Use a fresh composition rather than a generic pedestal.

commands.label: Product Universe 3D
commands.desc: Build a layered branded 3D world around the hero product.
commands.instruction: Create one static product-universe CGI creative with clear foreground, midground and background depth. Build a branded 3D world around the current product while preserving the product exactly. Use meaningful environmental forms instead of random floating decoration.

commands.label: Architectural 3D
commands.desc: Turn the brand/product into a premium architectural-scale environment.
commands.instruction: Create one static architectural CGI creative where the current product or brand language informs the spatial design. Use believable structure, scale, perspective and lighting; keep the product accurate and avoid generic sci-fi corridors.

commands.label: Billboard Breakout CGI
commands.desc: Product breaks beyond a billboard frame in a believable 3D illusion.
commands.instruction: Create one static billboard-breakout CGI creative. Build a realistic billboard or OOH structure and let the current product visually break beyond the frame with correct occlusion, scale, contact and perspective. Keep the billboard copy concise and factual.

commands.label: Anamorphic CGI
commands.desc: Forced-perspective 3D display illusion designed for one viewing angle.
commands.instruction: Create one static anamorphic CGI advertising illusion with strong forced perspective from a single intended viewpoint. The product must remain geometrically accurate while the surrounding 3D scene creates convincing depth beyond the display plane.

commands.label: Fake OOH 3D
commands.desc: Surreal oversized outdoor installation with photographic realism.
commands.instruction: Create one static fake-OOH CGI concept using the current subject/product as an oversized real-world installation. Make architecture, street scale, shadows, reflections and human/environmental scale cues believable. Do not turn it into a normal billboard.

commands.label: Giant Product 3D
commands.desc: Monumental product integrated into a real environment.
commands.instruction: Create one static giant-product CGI creative. Scale the exact current product to monumental size and integrate it convincingly into a real environment with correct perspective, contact, shadows, atmospheric depth and contextual scale cues.

commands.label: Mini World 3D
commands.desc: A believable miniature world built around or within the product.
commands.instruction: Create one static miniature-world CGI creative around or within the current product. Use coherent tiny architecture, people or environmental details only when useful, with believable scale hierarchy and macro-depth behavior. Preserve the product exactly.

commands.label: Portal 3D
commands.desc: Product bridges two worlds through a dimensional portal.
commands.instruction: Create one static portal CGI creative where the current product connects two visually distinct but coherent environments. Use believable portal depth, edge lighting, reflections and spatial continuity; keep the product unchanged.

commands.label: Zero Gravity 3D
commands.desc: Controlled zero-gravity composition with premium spatial choreography.
commands.instruction: Create one static zero-gravity CGI creative with the current product suspended in a physically coherent low-gravity scene. Use controlled spatial choreography and realistic material behavior; avoid random clutter or the usual centered floating-product template.

commands.label: Floating Sculpture 3D
commands.desc: Sculptural levitation composition with designed depth and balance.
commands.instruction: Create one static floating-sculpture CGI creative. Use levitation as a deliberate sculptural composition with foreground/midground/background depth, controlled shadows and visual balance. Keep the product exact and make the layout unlike generic floating-product ads.

commands.label: Exploded 3D
commands.desc: Exploded spatial visualization without inventing unseen product internals.
commands.instruction: Create one static exploded-view CGI creative. Separate only visible or supplied components logically in space. If internal construction is not provided, explode external packaging/accessories/graphic layers rather than inventing hidden internals.

commands.label: Cutaway 3D
commands.desc: Controlled cutaway visualization using only known structure.
commands.instruction: Create one static cutaway CGI visualization using only structure that is visible or explicitly supplied. Do not fabricate hidden internals. Make the sectioning clean, premium and readable while preserving recognizable exterior geometry.

commands.label: X-Ray 3D
commands.desc: Transparent technical-style 3D treatment without false internals.
commands.instruction: Create one static X-ray-style CGI creative. Use translucent shells, light volumes and layered material treatment to suggest transparency, but do not invent unseen internal components. Preserve supplied product geometry and artwork.

commands.label: Glass 3D
commands.desc: Premium translucent glass world with realistic refraction and caustics.
commands.instruction: Create one static glass-material CGI creative using physically plausible transparency, refraction, reflections and caustics. The glass treatment should shape the environment or supporting forms without turning the locked product itself into glass unless requested.

commands.label: Chrome 3D
commands.desc: Reflective metallic CGI world with controlled premium highlights.
commands.instruction: Create one static chrome/metal CGI creative with refined reflections, controlled highlight gradients and premium sculptural forms. Keep the supplied product materials accurate unless the user explicitly asks to chrome the product.

commands.label: Liquid Splash 3D
commands.desc: Physically believable liquid interaction built around the product.
commands.instruction: Create one static liquid-splash CGI creative with believable fluid shape, viscosity, droplets, contact and lighting. Choose liquid behavior that fits the current brief/category; do not imply an ingredient or product claim unless supplied.

commands.label: Particle Field 3D
commands.desc: Designed particle system forming motion, depth and brand energy.
commands.instruction: Create one static particle-field CGI creative where particles build purposeful depth, flow or brand energy around the current subject. Avoid generic dust clouds; use controlled particle scale, density, lighting and directional structure.

commands.label: Fabric Sculpture 3D
commands.desc: Premium cloth simulation as a sculptural advertising device.
commands.instruction: Create one static cloth/fabric CGI creative using believable folds, tension, weight and material response. Use fabric as a designed spatial device around the product rather than obscuring important labels or changing the product.

commands.label: Ice 3D
commands.desc: Frozen sculptural environment with realistic frost, melt and translucency.
commands.instruction: Create one static ice CGI creative with realistic translucency, trapped bubbles, frost, condensation or controlled melt where appropriate. Treat ice as the environment/supporting sculpture; do not invent temperature or performance claims.

commands.label: Fire / Heat 3D
commands.desc: Controlled cinematic heat, flame or ember CGI composition.
commands.instruction: Create one static fire/heat CGI creative using believable flame, ember, glow, smoke and heat interaction. Keep the product readable and undamaged unless the brief explicitly calls for destruction; do not imply unsupported performance claims.

commands.label: 3D Typography
commands.desc: Dimensional type becomes a major spatial element around the product.
commands.instruction: Create one static 3D-typography advertising creative. Build short supplied or non-factual campaign text as dimensional geometry integrated with the product through scale, depth, occlusion and lighting. Keep text highly readable and never invent factual claims.

commands.label: Neon 3D
commands.desc: Luminous volumetric CGI world with controlled emissive lighting.
commands.instruction: Create one static neon/emissive CGI creative with believable luminous materials, volumetric glow and reflected light. Keep the lighting premium and controlled rather than turning the whole scene into a generic cyberpunk look.

commands.label: Underwater 3D
commands.desc: Submerged CGI scene with convincing water optics and buoyancy.
commands.instruction: Create one static underwater CGI creative with believable refraction, caustics, suspended particles, buoyancy and depth falloff. Preserve product geometry and label readability; do not imply waterproofing unless supplied.

commands.label: Abstract Brand Sculpture 3D
commands.desc: Original sculptural 3D forms derived from current brand/category cues.
commands.instruction: Create one static abstract-brand CGI creative using original sculptural forms, materials and spatial rhythm derived only from current brand/category cues. Keep one clear hero idea and avoid recycled blobs, pedestals or unrelated generic shapes.
